AWS.label: yes
AWS.note: Copy backups to other AWS Regions/accounts on demand or in a backup plan

Acronis.label: yes
Acronis.note: Geo-redundant storage copies backups to a geographically distant secondary region

Afi.ai.label: yes
Afi.ai.note: Back up to several storages: copy in the cluster's region and a reserve copy in another region

Arcserve.label: yes
Arcserve.note: Copy recovery points to another data store on a remote site; replicate to Arcserve Cloud / remote RPS

Arctera.label: yes
Arctera.note: Offsite Copy copies recovery points to an offsite destination (external drive, S3/Azure)

Atempo.label: yes
Atempo.note: Duplication makes a second backup copy on another storage/site; remote sites replicate to central site

AvePoint.label: yes
AvePoint.product: Cloud Backup for IaaS + PaaS / Microsoft 365
AvePoint.note: Availability Paired Region (geo-redundant storage) replicates backup data to a paired secondary region

Axcient.label: yes
Axcient.note: Geo+ copies restore points to a geographically separate secondary region; site-to-site replication

Bacula.label: yes
Bacula.note: Offsite copies via Copy Jobs to a second Storage Daemon / Copy/Migration jobs

Barracuda.label: yes
Barracuda.note: Offsite replication to Barracuda Cloud Storage or another Barracuda Backup device

CloudCasa.label: yes
CloudCasa.note: Database backup option 'Copy to another region' stores backup data in another AWS region

Cohesity.label: yes
Cohesity.note: Configure a secondary region for backups; NetBackup duplicates backup images

Commvault.label: yes
Commvault.note: Multi-region backup plans add snapshot/backup copies for other regions

Datto.label: yes
Datto.note: Offsite sync of local backups to Datto cloud; secondary replication to a second offsite server; SIRIS Private secondary site

Dell.label: yes
Dell.note: Cascaded replication to a geographically distant disaster recovery site

Druva.label: yes
Druva.note: Cross-region backups create copies in up to two additional AWS regions; AWS account as DR secondary site

Eon.label: yes
Eon.note: Policies can back up to a vault in a different region or different cloud from the source

Flosum.label: unclear
Flosum.note: Best-practice advice to store copies in cloud and off-site; no product mechanism stated

GRAX.label: yes
GRAX.note: Passive storage sync supports AWS cross-region passive storage for DR

Gearset.label: unclear
Gearset.note: Only a manually downloaded metadata snapshot that 'can be used as an offsite backup'

Google.label: yes
Google.note: Backup vaults can be cross-regional/multi-regional; store backups off-site in a different region

HYCU.label: unclear
HYCU.note: Backup copy to a different storage account/target, but another region/site is not stated (auto target is same region)

Hornetsecurity (Altaro).label: yes
Hornetsecurity (Altaro).note: Offsite Copy Location sends a redundant copy of backups to an offsite location over WAN/VPN

IBM.label: yes
IBM.note: Replication from primary to disaster recovery site; offsite tape copy

Microsoft.label: yes
Microsoft.note: GRS replicates backups to an Azure paired secondary region; cross-region restore

N-Able.label: yes
N-Able.note: Backups saved remotely in the cloud or a private data center, with an optional additional local LocalSpeedVault copy

Nakivo.label: yes
Nakivo.note: Backup Copy jobs maintain additional copies of backups, incl. to cloud/offsite

Portworx.label: yes
Portworx.note: Cross-region backup and restore; 3-2-1 with backup locations in different regions

Red Hat.label: unclear
Red Hat.note: spot-check disagreement (unclear vs yes); set unclear. Multiple backup storage locations across regions/providers for redundancy, but no copying of a backup to a second location stated

Rubrik.label: yes
Rubrik.note: Rubrik Cloud Vault multi-region redundancy keeps a copy in a secondary region

Slide.label: yes
Slide.note: Slide Box replicates snapshots to the Slide Cloud for offsite storage

Storware.label: yes
Storware.note: Backup Copy replicates to a secondary destination in another storage location; tapes assignable to offsite location

Synology.label: yes
Synology.note: Backup copies sent to a remote site / remote storage or another appliance

Trilio.label: unclear
Trilio.note: Continuous restore stages backup PV data onto remote-site clusters; no explicit backup copy to another region/site

Unitrends.label: yes
Unitrends.note: Backup copy jobs to secondary/external targets for disaster recovery

Veeam.label: yes
Veeam.note: Backup copy jobs copy backups to secondary repositories onsite or offsite / cloud

Velero.label: unclear
Velero.note: Some backups can target a bucket in a different region, but no copy of a backup to a second region stated

Zerto.label: yes
Zerto.note: Remote DR VPG replicates to a remote site with Extended Journal Copy
